messages.subject: Healthy Fertilized and Hatching Parrot Eggs
parts:
We are specialized in the breeding of birds/parrots and we sell very fertile candle lit eggs of great parrots species. All our eggs are collected from very healthy birds in our aviary , candle tested and 100% confirmed fertile for hatching healthy babies. we deal with

Timneh Grey eggs,
Blue and Gold Macaw eggs,
Hyacinth Macaw eggs,
Congo African Grey eggs
Cockatoo
Amazons
Cockatiels
Senegal parrots
Pionus parrots
Conure parrots
Vassa parrots
Jardin parrots and some few others.

Contact us on parrot...@outlook.com and get a supply.
